## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check:all` passes.
- [ ] UI text goes through `locales/{en,tr}`, in both languages.
- [ ] No conversation content is parsed, stored or shown; no token is stored or logged.
- [ ] No real transcripts or personal usage data in fixtures, logs or screenshots.
- [ ] Budgeted paths (memory, CPU, latency, size) are measured if touched (`docs/perf/`).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes.
